$comment: Pi models.json template for the Mac local OpenAI-compatible Qwen server (llama-server single-model mode, NOT the llama.cpp router). One provider, three selectable profiles; port 8087 serves exactly one profile at a time, so select ONLY the model matching the currently running llama-server. Copy this file to <agent-dir>/models.json inside an isolated PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and invoke pi with that env var, e.g. PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=/tmp/pi-qwen-8087. See qwen-profile-selection.md. Selecting a profile does NOT switch llama-server.
